corpus.text: The global AI note-taking software market was estimated at USD 450 million in 2025 and is projected to reach USD 1.2 billion by 2030, representing a compound annual growth rate near 22 percent.
Adoption is strongest among remote teams, consulting firms, and sales organizations that need searchable meeting records and automated action items.
Otter offers a free tier and a business plan priced at approximately USD 20 per user each month when billed monthly.
Fireflies provides a free tier, a Pro plan near USD 18 per seat monthly, and a Business plan near USD 29 per seat monthly.
Interviewed buyers ranked transcript accuracy, data retention controls, CRM integrations, and reliable speaker identification as their leading purchase criteria.
The most common adoption barrier was concern about recording consent and the storage of confidential meeting content.

cases.reference_answer: Buyers prioritize transcript accuracy, retention controls, CRM integrations, and reliable speaker identification.
